LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription:
War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft from World War II and the Cold War. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea, fighting with millions of players from all over the world in an ever-evolving environment. 

Features include:

• Over 2500 highly detailed aircraft, tanks, warships, helicopters and other combat vehicles crafted carefully from historical documents and surviving sources. 
• More than 100 maps representing the main historical battle theaters. 
• Intense PvP experiences in full-scale combat missions at various difficulty settings for all play styles and degrees of experience. 
• Rich PvE content including dynamic historical campaigns and solo missions. 
• Regular content updates including new vehicles, maps, missions and nations. 
• Keyboard, mouse and Hotas One support. 
• Astonishing graphics, authentic sound effects and beautiful music creating an atmosphere to fully immerse yourself in.
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: War Thunder is the most comprehensive free-to-play MMO military game dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft from World War II and the Cold War. Join now and take part in major battles on land, in the air, and at sea, fighting with millions of players from all over the world in an ever-evolving environment.

Features: War Thunder - is the most comprehensive free action MMO, dedicated to aviation, armoured vehicles, and naval craft as from World War II and the Cold War, and also modern models.
Over 2,500 highly detailed aircraft, helicopters, tanks, warships and other combat vehicles crafted carefully from historical documents and surviving sources.
100 maps representing the main historical battle theaters.
Rich PVP and PVE content represented by a various multiplayer game modes and regular in-game events, historical and dynamic campaigns, solo missions and mission editor.
Regular content updates including new vehicles, maps, missions and nations.
Astonishing graphics, authentic sound effects and beautiful music creating an atmosphere to fully immerse yourself in.
LocalizedProperties.ReleaseNotes:
· In the Alpha Strike update, we've introduced new ground vehicles: premium rank VII vehicles for the USSR, Japan, Italy, Sweden, and Israel; the Fox light tank for Great Britain; Zerstörer 45 for Germany, and 120S — a hybrid of the M1A1 and M60A1 for the USA. 
 
· The update has brought Hungarian aircraft into the Italian aviation tree. From World War II classics like the IL-10 to the jet-powered MiG-15bis and JAS39C. Additionally, we've added the Alpha Jet for Germany and France, the premium rank VIII F-20A Tigershark for the USA, and Buccaneer S.2B with Martel missiles for the UK. 
 
· Some helicopter trees have received the following vehicles: Wessex HU Mk.5 for Great Britain, AH-1W with powerful Hellfire missiles for the USA and China, and the AH-60 Battle Hawk with Spike ER missiles for Israel. Additionally, all variants of the AH-64 have received a new detailed cockpit. 
 
· The naval fleet update includes: the premium HMS Diamond for Great Britain, the coastal American USS Dealey, the heavy cruiser RN Bolzano for Italy, the destroyer Kleber and the battleship Bretagne for France. Plus, the Japanese IJN Mutsu with the largest caliber guns in the game at 410 mm. 
 
· A new ground forces map, "Northern Holland," featuring a meticulously detailed city, numerous streets, and a large mall accessible for entry. We’ve also added the Golan Heights mission for Air Realistic Battles at top tier. 
 
· Game bug fixes, interface improvements, and and vehicle balance adjustments.
